paper_id: Convolutional Neural Networks over Tree Structures for Programming Language Processing
title: Convolutional Neural Networks over Tree Structures for Programming Language Processing
motivation: 传统NLP模型无法捕获程序丰富且明确的树结构信息
problem_framing: 将程序抽象语法树作为输入，设计卷积核提取结构特征
key_insight: 连续二叉树处理变长子节点数，动态池化解决不同AST的规模和形状差异
method_signature: TBCNN：编码层+树卷积层+动态池化层+全连接层
evaluation_criteria: 程序功能分类准确率、冒泡排序检测准确率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: RNN在结构较大时性能退化；预训练加速训练但对最终精度提升有限
evidence_for_taste: we think more effective neural models are in need
the result is quite sensible because it is consistent with human understanding
pretraining has a limited effect on the final accuracy
RNN's accuracy is lower than shallow methods
a boost of 1.3% in considering child nodes' order information
TBCNN's performance boost is not merely caused by using a better classifier
thinking_moves: 先用定性聚类验证向量表示合理性，再定量比较下游任务
承认预训练的局限：AST符号少(44个)，有监督学习足够
选择1-way而非3-way池化：简单方法同样有效则不增加复杂度
主动对比RNN显式指出其不适合大树结构，体现方法选择的审慎
将性能提升归因于结构特征提取而非分类器改进，区分贡献来源
cites_own_work: Peng et al. 2015 on program vector representations
Mou et al. 2015 on tree-based convolution for NLP
